builder.title: Builder and operator
builder.body: Ecosystem design and governance frameworks; issuer and verifier services; wallets and AI agents as Verifiable Services; operations.

certificator.title: Official certificator
certificator.body: Trains integrators to build on Verana and certifies the professionals who pass the exams, for Latin America.

phoneNumbers.title: Telco-certified phone numbers
phoneNumbers.body: The operator issues a credential that binds a phone number to a subscriber; every service that accepts it verifies the issuer on the public registry.

supportAgents.title: Verifiable customer-support agents
supportAgents.body: An operator's AI agent proves who operates it before a subscriber types a word. Running today in AI One.

sectors.title: Sector ecosystems in Latin America
sectors.body: Diplomas, licenses, certifications and memberships that any partner can verify, governed by the body that issues them.

cert.title: Get Verana certified
cert.body: Mobiera trains integrators to build on Verana and certifies the professionals who pass the exams. Designated by the Verana Foundation. Valid until May 2029.

telecom.title: Software that runs inside the operator's network

aircast.title: Aircast
aircast.body: Campaigns over the operator's network. Any handset, no data, no balance. STK push marketing, bulk SMS and MMS, and SIM OTA campaigns from one engine, at whatever throughput your SMSC allows.

aiOne.title: AI One
aiOne.body: AI agents your subscribers can reach on any phone, and verify. Customer support over SMS and Hologram, integrated with your billing, identified with verifiable credentials so nobody can impersonate your operator.

openSource.title: Sixteen public repositories
openSource.body: Libraries for ETSI TS 102.221, 102.222, 102.225 and 102.226, a GlobalPlatform card-content manager, the Aircast integration APIs, and the stats and service-log containers.

cta.title: Tell us what you are building
cta.body: Every message reaches the right person. No sales queue, no email to guess.
